summary.text: Eric Michael Foreman, a Libertarian Party candidate with a career in property management, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Nebraska's 2nd Congressional District to Denise Powell.
He advanced from the May 12, 2026 Libertarian Party primary to the general election.

paragraphs.text: Foreman describes himself as a blue-collar worker who has "worked honest jobs" and is not a career politician, and he says he has raised a family "the hard way—without handouts or shortcuts."
He advanced from the May 12, 2026 Libertarian Party primary to the general election ballot.
His campaign centered on ending U.S. involvement in foreign wars, cutting taxes for people earning under $200,000, and opposing what he called government overreach.
He received 2.6% of the vote to Denise Powell's 56.6%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
